layer_map.what: New hand-authored `@font-face` block referencing bundled woff2

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Single hand-authored `fonts.css` with explicit `@font-face` per weight (Inter 400/500/600/700, JetBrains Mono 400/700), `font-display:swap`, `url()` → `@fontsource` woff2
key_design_decisions.why: AC-1 forces hand-authored `@font-face`; AC-8 swap; one file = one reviewable provenance surface, decoupled from `@fontsource` CSS internals
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Importing each `@fontsource/*/400.css`: violates AC-1 (not hand-authored), pulls in vendor `@font-face` we don't control, harder to pin latin-only/weights (§6 OOS creep)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Edit value in `tokens.css:62` (Inter first); value-only, NO `@font-face` added; leave a comment: "move to design/tokens.json if generation pipeline is restored"
key_design_decisions.why: tokens.css is the de-facto in-repo source (tokens.json + script absent); AC-7 needs Inter to win on macOS; AC-13 holds (value edit, no `@font-face`). **DEPARTURE**: editing a file documented "GENERATED, never hand-edit" — justified: no generator/source exists, so the doc-invariant is unenforceable and tokens.css IS the source
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Adding `@font-face` here: breaks AC-13. Overriding order in fonts.css/base.css: splits the sans stack across two files, harder to trace

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Replace `body{font-family: Inter, -apple-system, …}` with `body{font-family: var(--font-sans)}`; keep antialiasing/optimizeLegibility
key_design_decisions.why: Design parity (design body uses `var(--font-sans)`); §4 no hardcoded font-family literal; makes the D2 reorder actually take effect. **DEPARTURE**: replacing electron-vite starter body rule — justified as removing starter cruft, in feature intent
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Leaving cruft: hardcoded `Inter` first would mask the token, silently diverge from design, violate §4

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Assert LOADED typeface at runtime: `document.fonts.check`/`.load` for Inter + JetBrains Mono AND `getComputedStyle().fontFamily` resolves to them; NOT a pixel-diff vs `reference.html`
key_design_decisions.why: `reference.html` on macOS renders `-apple-system`/SF for sans, so a pixel-diff would assert the wrong (fallback) glyphs; AC-7/AC-12 are about the loaded face, not pixel match; AC-5 (colors/geometry) stays a separate token assertion
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Screenshot pixel-diff vs reference: false pass/fail from platform font substitution (per memory: CT fidelity misses typeface)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: `url()` points into `@fontsource/*/files/*.woff2` inside `node_modules`; let electron-vite/vite fingerprint + emit them; NO manual copy to `assets/fonts/`
key_design_decisions.why: Single source of truth (the dep), no duplicated binaries in-repo, vite already fingerprints CSS `url()` assets; AC-4 offline satisfied (bundled at build), AC-10 no remote URLs
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: Copying woff2 into `src/renderer/src/assets/fonts/`: duplicates binaries, manual sync burden, drifts from `@fontsource` version

file_impact.what_changes: Hand-authored `@font-face` × 6 (Inter 400/500/600/700, JetBrains Mono 400/700), `font-display: swap`, `src: url()` → `@fontsource` woff2 (latin)
Reorder `--font-sans:62` so `'Inter'` precedes `-apple-system`; add restore-to-pipeline comment. No `@font-face`. No other token change
Replace body `font-family` literal stack with `var(--font-sans)`; keep antialiasing/optimizeLegibility/other body props
Add a loaded-typeface assertion (document.fonts + getComputedStyle == Inter/JetBrains Mono) per D4; regenerate affected CT screenshot baselines (rm + re-generate stale PNGs)

doc_impact.what_changes: Record `fonts.css` as the second file in the styles concern; note self-hosted Inter/JetBrains Mono via `@font-face` (AC-9)

risks.risk: `@fontsource` `url()` path fails to resolve/bundle in electron-vite renderer build
risks.mitigation: Reference the exact `@fontsource/*/files/*-latin-<w>-normal.woff2` paths; verify the built bundle emits the woff2 + resolves at the renderer origin (dev + `electron-vite build`) as part of AC-4/AC-11

risks.risk: Editing GENERATED `tokens.css` is normalized away if a token pipeline is later restored
risks.mitigation: Value-only reorder + inline "restore via design/tokens.json" comment; AC-13 gate asserts no `@font-face` lands there; scope stays §6-bounded

risks.risk: Sans reorder → app renders Inter on macOS while reference.html renders SF; strict pixel-diff CT vs reference would flag it
risks.mitigation: Assert the intended LOADED typeface (D4), not a pixel-diff vs reference's mac-resolved face; document intent-over-reference

risks.risk: FOUT / layout shift from `font-display: swap` alters existing CT screenshot baselines
risks.mitigation: `swap` is intended (AC-8) + metric-compatible fallbacks; rm + regenerate affected CT PNG baselines (sub-threshold diffs otherwise stay stale)
CSS `url()`/asset-only path (D5), never a JS `require` of node/electron; typecheck confirms no node imports (AC-11)

risks.risk: `@fontsource` adds woff2 binaries to the bundle
risks.mitigation: Latin subset only, static weights (Inter 400/500/600/700 + JetBrains Mono 400/700)

specialist_consultation.sub_question: Layer map + key design decisions + constitution/OOS trace for self-hosted font loading
specialist_consultation.input_summary: Authored D1-D5, layer map, risk seeds; flagged D2/D3 as DEPARTUREs; no specialist consult needed

dependencies: - `@fontsource/inter` — npm dependency (woff2 source for Inter 400/500/600/700, latin).
- `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` — npm dependency (woff2 source for JetBrains Mono 400/700, latin).
- No services, no environment variables, no CSP change.
